hints.title: Define Path Effort
hints.text: The effort of a path is the maximum absolute elevation difference between consecutive cells along the path.

hints.title: Shortest Path Formulation
hints.text: Frame the problem as finding a path minimizing the maximum edge weight using Dijkstra or binary search.

hints.title: Relaxation Rule
hints.text: New effort to reach neighbor is maximum of current effort and absolute difference to neighbor.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple breadth-first search cannot minimize maximum bottleneck weights without cost prioritization.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dijkstra priority queue guarantees finding minimum bottleneck path in O(V log V) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as a minimax path problem solved via Dijkstra or binary search with BFS.

solutions.approach: Dijkstra priority queue for minimax edge effort
